defs.meaning: 限制，制约；起限制作用的规则（或事实、条件）；局限，缺陷；追诉时效

examples.en: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
examples.zh: 他们会抵制对他们权力的任何限制。

examples.en: All the talk had been about the limitation of nuclear weapons.
examples.zh: 整个会谈都是关于核武器的限制。

examples.en: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
examples.zh: 这种药物有一个很大的限制因素，其药效只能持续6个小时。

synonyms.meaning: 限制；限度；极限；追诉时效；有效期限
